name: Digital Signature for eCommerce Checkout
author: Pluginorbit

sections.description:
Digital Signature for eCommerce Checkout adds a digital signature field to your WooCommerce checkout, allowing customers to sign orders directly with a mouse, stylus, or finger.

Use it to collect WooCommerce digital signatures for rental agreements, service waivers, delivery consent, customer acknowledgements, age-verification acknowledgements, and other order-related sign-offs.

Customers can draw their signature directly on the WooCommerce checkout signature pad before completing an order. The signed signature is saved as an image and linked to the order, where it can be viewed from the customer order details page and the WooCommerce admin order screen.

The plugin supports both the classic WooCommerce checkout and the WooCommerce Checkout block, making it suitable for modern WooCommerce stores.

No third-party e-signature service is required.

Features

  • WooCommerce checkout signature field: Add a responsive signature field to the checkout page.
  • Digital signature for WooCommerce: Collect customer signatures before an order is completed.
  • Draw with mouse or finger: Customers can sign using a mouse, stylus, or touch-enabled device.
  • Responsive signature pad: Designed for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Custom signature pad styling: Customize the width, height, pen color, and background color.
  • Flexible field position: Choose where the signature field appears on the checkout and order details pages.
  • PNG or JPEG signatures: Choose the image format used to save customer signatures.
  • Required signature field: Make the signature mandatory before checkout can be completed.
  • Custom field label: Change the signature field label to match your store.
  • Clear, Undo, and Redo controls: Allow customers to correct their signature before submitting.
  • Frontend download button: Optionally allow customers to download their signature.
  • Custom button labels and colors: Customize the Clear, Undo, Redo, and Download buttons.
  • WooCommerce Media Library storage: Automatically save the signature image to the WordPress Media Library and link it to the order.
  • WooCommerce order signature: View the customer’s signed signature on the order details page and WooCommerce admin order screen.
  • WooCommerce Checkout block support: Works with both the Checkout block and classic shortcode checkout.

Want More? (Pro Features)

Upgrade to Digital Signature for eCommerce Checkout Pro for additional signature capture and order documentation features:

  • Type-to-sign mode: Allow customers to type their name as a styled signature or switch between Draw and Type modes.
  • Product and order restrictions: Display the signature field only for selected product categories or orders above a minimum amount.
  • GDPR consent checkbox: Add a customizable consent checkbox with validation.
  • Logged-in user restriction: Require customers to be logged in before signing.
  • IP address and browser information: Capture additional order signing information for an audit trail.
  • Tamper-evidence hash: Generate a hash to help verify signature data.
  • Timestamp embedding: Add a timestamp directly to the signature image.
  • Admin signature download: Download customer signatures from the WooCommerce admin order screen.
  • Signature in order emails: Include the customer’s signature in WooCommerce order confirmation emails.
  • Signed PDF invoice: Attach a signed PDF invoice with your store logo to customer emails.
  • Signature column and filter: Add signature status information to the WooCommerce orders list with filtering and bulk ZIP export.
  • Signature statistics: View signed and unsigned order statistics from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Automatic signature deletion: Configure automatic deletion of stored signatures after a selected retention period.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Digital Signature to configure the signature field, position, appearance, and validation settings.
sections.faq:
Is the digital signature legally binding?

The plugin captures a customer’s signature as an image and stores it with the order. Whether a digital signature is legally binding depends on applicable laws, regulations, and how the signature is used. The Pro version provides additional audit-trail features such as IP address, browser information, timestamp, and tamper-evidence hash.

Can I require the signature field on WooCommerce checkout?

Yes. Enable the Make Signature Required setting to require customers to provide a signature before checkout can be completed.

Does the WooCommerce signature pad work on mobile devices?

Yes. The signature pad is responsive and supports touch input on phones and tablets.

Does it work with the WooCommerce Checkout block?

Yes. The plugin supports both the classic WooCommerce shortcode checkout and the WooCommerce Checkout block.

Can I customize the WooCommerce signature field?

Yes. You can customize the signature field label, pen width, pen color, background color, and canvas size from the plugin settings.

Where can I see the customer’s signature after checkout?

The customer’s signature is available on the order’s Order Details page in My Account and on the WooCommerce order edit screen in the WordPress admin.
